correctness.rationale: An orthogonal degree-0/1/2 scalar, tangential-vector, traceless-tensor decomposition completely diagonalizes the signed-hemisphere concentration operator. Beta moments produce exactly one scalar nonzero singular value and one repeated tangential-vector value, plus exact midpoint nullity. Strict contraction comes from polynomial nonvanishing on open spherical patches; extrema/condition number follow from the full spectrum. Explicit rational dimension-step inequalities and gamma-ratio limits are verified analytically. A separate monomial Gram-matrix checker compared 268 eigenvalues on spheres d=3..10, but is supporting finite evidence only.

originality.rationale: The established general Slepian cap integral matrices already imply a calculable degree-two S^2 specialization, and the hemisphere midpoint law is prior. The distinct result checked here is the explicit complete quadratic low-pass spectrum simultaneously for every S^{d-1}, d>=3, with its two exact noncentral constants, all eigenspaces and optimal conditioning. Primary text and corresponding archived-claim summaries were compared at the level of mathematical implications, not merely titles. Residual historical priority risk remains.
residual_risks: The full bodies of indexed near-neighbor midpoint and zonal determinant publications were not retrieved; their summaries might omit relevant generalizations.
General cap matrix theory could indirectly imply special d=3 and perhaps an unlocated higher-dimensional extension.
Unindexed or differently named higher-dimensional sphere research may contain equivalent closed forms.

value.rationale: The low-pass quadratic harmonic space is the first band mixing scalar, vector, and traceless-tensor structure. A dimension-uniform complete hemisphere spectrum provides exact sharp concentration, singular values, stable restriction benchmarks, complete maximizing eigenspaces, and asymptotic constants. The new noncentral eigenvalues and sharp norms are not trivial restatements of general Slepian existence or half-energy symmetry. Scope is strictly degree≤2 noiseless hemispherical geometry.
